view_frame: The drawing presents a wheel disc in two views. The FRONT view (XZ plane) shows the circular face of the wheel with the hub, spokes, and rim. The RIGHT view (YZ plane) shows the side profile, indicating the wheel's thickness along the Y-axis. The world axes are defined as: X is the horizontal width in the front view, Z is the vertical height in the front view, and Y is the depth (thickness) of the wheel.

The rim is a continuous circular band connected to the spokes.

edit_rules: Changing the OD (120 mm) scales the entire wheel profile.
Changing the thickness (8 mm) adjusts the extrusion depth along the Y-axis.
Changing the number of spokes (8) requires regenerating the spoke pattern.
Changing the hub diameter (ASSUMED 30 mm) adjusts the inner circle radius.
Changing the rim width (ASSUMED 10 mm) adjusts the inner radius of the rim.
Changing the spoke width (ASSUMED 10 mm) adjusts the width of the radial spokes.
